verdicts.reason: A: the NEW FLAVOR pill sits on top of the SOLSTICE logo. The sun mark is half covered and the wordmark is tiny and faint inside the decorative circle, so the brand is effectively lost and the left end is a jumbled cluster. The headline, subcopy and CTA are well arranged. B: the badge, logo, can, headline and CTA read cleanly from left to right with the logo intact, but the subcopy is crammed into a narrow five-line column of tiny text with one-word lines like 'hour.', which is close to illegible. There is also uneven spacing between the can and the headline.
